# Optional developer translation probe

Optional developer-only text translation probe (not a bundled client model):
Helsinki-NLP / University of Helsinki Language Technology Research Group,
original zho-eng opus-2020-07-17 Marian archive, linked by the publisher model card
https://huggingface.co/Helsinki-NLP/opus-mt-zh-en . The artifact's own LICENSE is
CC-BY-4.0. Original LICENSE/README are retained in notices/opus-mt-zho-eng-20200717-*.
Research conversion: CTranslate2 4.8.3 OPUS converter, INT8 serialization; no derived
weights or inference runtime binaries are distributed in this repository/APK.
CTranslate2 is MIT; optional pip dependencies retain their own licensing.
Full client/runtime distribution auditing and mobile acceptance remain outstanding.
See docs/ENGLISH_TRANSLATION_PROBE.md for provenance and observed quality limits.

The original package README and license are preserved byte-for-byte. Published upstream benchmark values in that README are not ZapIME measurements.
